da-non-sequitur.evidence: Full review 2026-11-21. The proof does not establish its statement. (1) Step 3 (no level >= 3 term) rests on 'pentagon ascension' cited from rem:mass-endomorphism-jet-tower, a remark, not a proved block; no rewriting of Phi_q(|V_i V_j V_k|) into order <= 2 factors is exhibited, and 'iteration covers all higher orders' is asserted, not shown. (2) Step 2 says the three summands are identified with beta_empty, beta_{i}, beta_{i,j} 'term-by-term. Direct.' with no argument, and imports the formula from prop:mass-endomorphism-tower, which the statement's own banner says supersedes this scalar form (the block is marked Superseded). (3) Step 4 claims each summand lies in Z[q^{+-1/2}], but the statement uses the Frobenius norm, which involves a square root of a sum of squares and is not in that Laurent ring in general; and Phi_q is an infinite product that 'reduces to a polynomial when truncated at the GB-filtration level appropriate for the partition data', a truncation chosen, not derived, so the summand is not a well-defined ring element. (4) The statement's final claim, that the stratification identifies exactly with the J^{|S|}/J^{|S|+1} grading of the GS confinement filtration, is not addressed by any step. Step 1 is fine but trivial. No empirical data used and no ruling conflicts. Recommend demoting to remark or conjecture, consistent with its Superseded banner.

trap-nonspeakable.notes: RIGOR — Phi_q CONVENTION DRIFT, three incompatible definitions inside one chapter, two of them in this batch. Step 4 of this block writes 'the quantum dilogarithm Phi_q is given as a formal product prod_{n>=0} (1 - q^n . x) in Z[q][[x]]'. The sibling rem:phi-q-resums-trace-series displays Phi_q(z) = prod_{k>=1} (1 - q^{-k} z)^{-1}, and prf:phi-q-categorical-truncation uses Phi_q^{[<=k]}(z) = prod_{j=1}^{k} (1 - q^{-j} z)^{-1}. Those differ from this one in THREE independent ways: the reciprocal (this block has no exponent -1, so it is the Pochhammer (x;q)_infinity, which is the INVERSE of the other two), the sign of the exponent (q^{+n} here, q^{-k} there — and with q_0 = 1.10998 > 1 the two have opposite convergence behaviour, since only q^{-k} -> 0), and the starting index (n >= 0 here, k >= 1 there, a factor of (1 - x)). The discrepancy is not cosmetic for this step's own argument: Step 4's conclusion that Phi_q 'reduces to a polynomial when truncated' is TRUE for the Pochhammer written here and FALSE for the reciprocal written in the two sibling blocks, where a truncation is a rational function — which is exactly why prf:phi-q-categorical-truncation calls its truncation 'a finite product' rather than a polynomial. Proposed: fix one convention chapter-wide and state it once at the definition (def:quantum-bloch-group or def:phi-q-piece), then have every block cite it. VERIFIED OK in this block: Step 4's claim that no convergence condition on |q| is needed is correct for the formal-power-series reading; Step 3's pentagon reduction of order-3 to order-<=2 plus a level-(n+1) residual matches prop:pentagon-uv-commutation exactly. MINOR: the JSJ section calls rem:phi-q-tower-jsj-bridge 'The conjecture', but that label is a rem:, not a conj:.
